description: GHOST OHCH: the closed and open hi-hats on one sound path, so that hitting the closed hat cuts off an open hat that is ringing

params.text: Sets the pitch of the closed hat
Sets how long the closed hat rings
Sets the closed hat's output level
Sets the pitch of the open hat
Sets how long the open hat rings
Sets the open hat's output level

inputs.text: Fires the closed hat on a rise past 2V, and silences any open hat that is ringing
Fires the open hat on a rise past 2V
Raises the level and the accent character of a closed-hat hit while it is high at the moment of its trigger, as Accent B; the open hat ignores it
Raises the level and the accent character of a hit on either hat while it is high at the moment of its trigger, as Accent A, shared by the whole kit
Adds to the closed tune knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the closed decay knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the closed level knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the open tune knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the open decay knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the open level knob, the whole knob range over 10V

notes: the total accent jack reads as accented while nothing is patched into it, so a voice on its own sounds at its accented level until you patch an accent gate
the accent amounts and master level come from a GHOST CTRL touching this module, or reaching it along a row of touching Ghost modules; with no controller the voice runs at its own settings
a fresh open-hat trigger re-arms the voice after a choke
menu: Drive (internal saturation) — two sliders, one per hat, setting a saturation amount that has no knob on the panel and no CV jack
